config.scope: Research: retention0; local RF1 v26.2.3; aged capture with independent gross financial/SQL workload and cold resolver restore; finite lifecycle profile off

policy.units: one timed SELL = one trade = one verified commitment = one resolved context; seeded BUY makers excluded from timed rates
policy.deadlineMeasurement: read_committed counts received before parent monotonic spawn+duration, minus preflight; conservative lower bound
policy.drainMeasurement: last observed full count minus parent spawn+Go HTTP elapsed; conservative upper bound, not per-trade latency

latency.resolution: 1ms ceiling buckets; overflow percentile upper is observed maximum

matchingWork.resolution: 1ms ceiling buckets; overflow percentile upper is observed maximum

entryToVerifiedVisibilityUpper.resolution: 1ms ceiling buckets; overflow percentile upper is observed maximum

batchEntryTiming.semantics: trade-weighted batch createdAt before matching execution to workFinishedAt, and createdAt to read_committed verified poll-return visibility upper bound; conservative whole-batch path bound, not individual command matching acceptance latency; createdAt is metadata excluded from payload and timing checksums; workFinishedAt timing integrity checked

producerCreateTimeMinusWorkFinished.resolution: 1ms ceiling buckets; overflow percentile upper is observed maximum

visibilityMinusProducerCreateTime.resolution: 1ms ceiling buckets; overflow percentile upper is observed maximum

timestampDiagnostics.semantics: CreateTime only: producer creation minus matching work is processing/publication diagnostic, not durable latency; visibility minus producer creation includes transaction commit and observer delivery/processing, not pure observer lag; producer timestamp truncation permits negative work delta up to999999ns, clamped0 and counted

result.observerCost: all verified records plus full source checksum validation once per source batch; four bounded source readers; live CPU/fetch overhead included
result.latencySemantics: batch matching workFinishedAt to observer poll-return read_committed verified visibility upper bound; includes checksum/source publication/extractor/verifier transaction/fetch/scheduling; not semantic acceptedAt, individual matching acceptance or producer timestamp
result.clockAssumption: matching and observer wall clocks share local host; negative intervals fail; wall steps reported

load.jobAccounting: completedTrades and legacy completedPairs count fully acknowledged trade jobs; pairs fields are legacy job counters; actual completed trades require canonical source/verified/resolved reconciliation; aggressor maker seeding occurs before load window
load.deadlineAccounting: validated durable HTTP acknowledgement observed strictly before fixed monotonic load-start plus requested duration; late/equal acknowledgements count only in acceptedOrders; epoch fields expose wall time from those same Go instants
load.receiptDrainAccounting: drainMs runs from HTTP worker completion before stopping the progress observer through successful receipt reconciliation; includes any outstanding observer query wait; acceptedAllEpochMs records worker completion even if requests failed
